features.feature: Contract reading: any state's purchase agreement, dates, parties, contingencies
features.quote: Any state's purchase agreement, even handwritten. Every date, party, and contingency extracted.
every date, including relative deadlines like "five business days after acceptance" or "seven business days before closing."
the document gets read, the affected dates update, and the tasks that no longer apply are flagged

features.feature: Inbox reading: every email matched to the right deal
features.quote: Every incoming email matched to the right deal, even with no address in the subject line.

features.feature: Scheduled reminders to parties ahead of key deadlines, sent from the user's Gmail or Outlook
features.quote: sends scheduled reminders to parties ahead of key deadlines. All from your Gmail or Outlook.

features.feature: Email modes: auto-reply drafts, on-demand drafts, scheduled reminders; human sends
features.quote: You review and send. Nothing leaves without you.

features.feature: SMS: text Ava a question about any deal
features.quote: Text Ava a question about any deal and get an answer from your actual file.

features.feature: Calendar sync: one event per deadline with parties invited
features.quote: It creates a calendar event for every deadline in Google Calendar or Outlook, with all parties invited, all from a single message.

features.feature: Ava Sign: e-signature filled from deal data, signature tracking, executed copy filed back on the deal
features.quote: When it is signed, the executed copy files itself back on the deal automatically.
Ask what is outstanding across all your files, what is due today, or how your closings are tracking

features.feature: Team Dashboard: overdue items per teammate
features.quote: An admin-only view of whether each teammate is keeping up: active transactions, overdue items, and tasks completed this week.

features.feature: Compliance Scan: missing signatures, mismatched dates, blank fields graded by severity
features.quote: Ava scans every document at intake for missing signatures, mismatched dates, and blank fields, grades each finding by severity

features.feature: Integrations: Gmail, Outlook, Follow Up Boss, Calendar
features.quote: Connect Gmail, Outlook, Follow Up Boss, and Calendar.
